doc: Acceptance convergence vectors for the Review Intelligence coverage slice (Task D1). Hand-authored predicate inputs and expected outcomes: never generated from the production convergence function. Each weakened case differs from the all-clear input in exactly one obligation, and the suite asserts each mutation refuses.

routes.doc: Every convergence route refuses one outstanding file: the review writer downgrades, both label rules hold green, and both status paths refuse stale or incomplete green state.
routes.review_writer: a converged verdict with one file unexaminable records blocked with the debt named, applies no converged label
routes.review_label: PassLabelWithCoverage holds PassConverged only when the predicate is true
routes.resolve_label: ResolvePassLabelWithCoverage reports a no-commit settle converged only when the predicate is true
routes.status_labelled: a converged label is honoured only when the markers underwrite it at the current head
routes.status_unlabelled: a converged verdict reports green only with the marker half met at the current head
